benchmark_type_evidence: We present IndicParam, a human-curated benchmark of over 13,000 multiple-choice questions covering 11 such languages
brief_description: A human-curated benchmark of over 13,000 multiple-choice questions covering 11 low- and extremely low-resource Indic languages, sourced from UGC-NET graduate-level examinations administered by the Government of India. Questions are classified as language understanding or general knowledge, and annotated with six question types (MCQ, assertion & reason, list matching, fill in the blanks, identify incorrect statement, ordering).
